task_instance: Created a small Rust library crate (buggy_parser) with a deliberate out-of-bounds slice bug in parse_buf(), ran `cargo fuzz init` to scaffold a fuzz/ directory, wrote a libFuzzer harness (fuzz_target_1.rs) calling buggy_parser::parse_buf(data), installed the nightly toolchain and cargo-fuzz, ran `cargo +nightly fuzz run fuzz_target_1`, and reproduced the resulting crash artifact with `cargo +nightly fuzz run fuzz_target_1 fuzz/artifacts/fuzz_target_1/crash-<hash>`.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/trailofbits__skills__cargo-fuzz/buggy_parser. Steps run: `rustup install nightly` (succeeded, installed rustc 1.101.0-nightly), `cargo install cargo-fuzz` (succeeded, v0.13.2), `cargo new --lib buggy_parser`, wrote src/lib.rs with parse_buf() containing an unchecked `&data[1..1+n]` slice, `cargo fuzz init` created fuzz/Cargo.toml and fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_target_1.rs, edited the harness to call buggy_parser::parse_buf(data), then ran `cargo +nightly fuzz run fuzz_target_1 -- -max_total_time=60`. The fuzzer found a crash within the very first seed iteration (single-byte input 0x0a = 10, which makes n=10 while only 0 bytes remain after the length byte), aborting with 'attempt to index slice... range end index out of range' and libFuzzer reporting SUMMARY: libFuzzer: deadly signal. It wrote the crash artifact to fuzz/artifacts/fuzz_target_1/crash-adc83b19e793491b1c6ea0fd8b46cd9f32e592fc (verified present via `ls`). Reproduced deterministically with `cargo +nightly fuzz run fuzz_target_1 fuzz/artifacts/fuzz_target_1/crash-adc83b19e793491b1c6ea0fd8b46cd9f32e592fc`, which crashed identically with the same stack trace pointing at buggy_parser::parse_buf in src/lib.rs:12. This confirms the skill's core deliverable -- setting up cargo-fuzz on a Rust crate, writing a fuzz_target! harness, running a fuzzing campaign under nightly, and reproducing a discovered crash artifact -- works end-to-end in this runtime.
